# Zerobugg

> Zerobugg is an integrated digital partner: strategy, product design, web and software development, AI automation, digital growth and analytics — delivered by one accountable team. Zerobugg helps businesses diagnose the constraint holding growth back, prioritize the roadmap and ship the work.

Zerobugg works with ambitious businesses that want one team accountable for both the plan and the delivery, instead of coordinating separate agencies for consulting, design, engineering and marketing.

## Services

- [Business & Technology Consulting](https://zerobugg.in/services/consulting): business analysis, digital strategy, product strategy and an executable transformation roadmap.
- [UI/UX & Product Design](https://zerobugg.in/services/ui-ux): UX research, information architecture, prototyping, usability testing and design systems.
- [Website & E-commerce Development](https://zerobugg.in/services/web-development): fast, accessible business websites and storefronts built around the customer journey.
- [Software Development](https://zerobugg.in/services/software-development): custom software, integrations and internal tools when off-the-shelf products do not fit.
- [SEO](https://zerobugg.in/services/seo): technical SEO, content strategy and sustainable organic growth programs.
- [Digital & Performance Marketing](https://zerobugg.in/services/digital-marketing): growth strategy, content, paid campaigns and conversion measurement.
- [AI & Business Automation](https://zerobugg.in/services/ai-automation): practical AI integrations and workflow automation with clear human review.
- [Analytics & Business Intelligence](https://zerobugg.in/services/analytics): trusted tracking, dashboards and evidence-led decision support.
